notes.title: 9 languages supported/build-up system/quest system/improvement and convenience
notes.notes:
[b]◆◆Update contents (2022.03.29) ◆◆[/b]

● Supports 9 languages.
한국어/ English/ 中國简体/ 中國繁体/ Russian/ Spanish/ German/ French/ 日本語

●Tutorial has been improved.
We'll guide you through the rules and precautions of the game.

● Improved convenience in PC environment.
I have improved convenience by supporting shortcut keys in PC environment.


●Add build-up system
Resource production facilities, unit production facilities, repair facilities, etc. can be upgraded.
You can upgrade the ability and invincible time of various units.
You can build up the warp function.

●Add a quest system
Those who start the game for the first time will learn how to play the game by following the quest.


● Improving the hero system
Heroes are divided into grades A, B, and C. You can hire grade A heroes and operate the unit strongly. However, it is not easy to get high-quality heroes.


[b]◆ ◆ Roadmap ◆ ◆[/b]

▶World
There are various hostile forces (boss-level unmanned weapons, bandits, terrorist groups, extremist religious groups, anti-government forces, ECT, ED) in the world. Destroy the ECT and cut off the enemy's energy. Through ED, we have to defend against enemies invading by warp. Boss-level unmanned weapons are huge. corps support is needed so that the hero aboard the dedicated machine can destroy the boss.

▶ Building
City Hall, corps Command, Science and Technology Center, Armored Vehicle Factory, Tank Factory, Self-propelled artillary Factory, Rocket Missile Factory, Unit Hangar, Production Factory, Base Command, Missile Development Center, Missile Silo.
You can build and deploy more than 20 different buildings.

▶ Agents and Soldiers
Agents and soldiers operate buildings and vehicles. We train them and upgrade them. There are various types of agents. After destroying the enemy's defensive weapons, they infiltrate the enemy's base. The infiltrators control the base's systems and administrative agencies. This will completely take over the enemy base.
Search teams search the world for dangerous elements such as ECT and ED of alien forces, alien bosses and bandits. 
The exploration team finds important parts, blueprints and heroes.
The inspection team monitors criminals and terrorists in the city.
Diplomatic intelligence monitors the enemy for signs of invasion or smuggling weapons.

▶ Corps system
Several troops are organized into corpses. You can train your corps to perform specialized operational skills. Battles of cities, boss destruction, defense...

▶core system
Core has a specific effect. Lead the battle to an advantage by using the core, which has an advantage over the opponent.  The enemy boss with Alpha core is at a disadvantage in battle against units with Beta core and dedicated machines. A corps of tanks equipped with Beta core has the effect of increasing mobility. 

▶ Missile vehicles and other units...
Vehicles operating drones, units equipped with anti-tank missiles, units specializing in sniping, vehicles launching cruise missiles, etc.Develop and produce various units.

▶ Generation 3 tanks and units
Develop and produce 3rd generation tanks and units. K2, Leopard, M1abrams, Mercava 
The units are equipped with an infrared system capable of firing and attacking at night. It is also equipped with a defense system to avoid enemy attacks.
Each unit has differentiated characteristics such as activation, defense, avoidance, and joint engagement.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779971/6c3c3db45252c637a92b0e6b03fa86b140abce09.png[/img]
[This image is for your reference]

▶ Hero & dedicated machine
The nanomachines injected into the hero's body work with the core.  The hero adjusts the core and operates a huge dedicated machine. There are various types of special machines. Vehicle shape, tank shape, mech shape, spider unit shape



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779971/94513e290faf5f014c2e3654492bc6496717a26b.png[/img]
[This image is for your reference]

▶Boss-class alien unmanned weapon
To destroy a huge boss, players must manage strategic assets such as corps, core, heroes, and dedicated machines. corps tanks first destroy the bridge of the boss in the form of a spider unit, stopping the boss from moving. Then, if you disable the core of the boss with a dedicated machine, you can finally destroy the boss.

▶GGMB
It is a huge base that travels above the ground like an aircraft carrier on the sea.  Fuel and repair the unit here.  It is essential for long-distance operations that cannot be warped.
